hero.title: Trump allows cheaper, dyed diesel on highways to blunt historic fuel-cost spike ahead of midterms
hero.description: The U.S. national average price of diesel topped $6 a gallon in September for the first time ever, as fuel supply disruptions pushed up transportation costs in the country.

latest.title: Trump allows cheaper, dyed diesel on highways to blunt historic fuel-cost spike ahead of midterms
latest.description: The U.S. national average price of diesel topped $6 a gallon in September for the first time ever, as fuel supply disruptions pushed up transportation costs in the country.

latest.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
latest.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: Better Markets says CFTC is ‘wrong agency’ to regulate retail crypto
latest.description: Better Markets said the CFTC’s proposed framework to bring certain cryptocurrency transactions and exchanges under its oversight will leave investors less protected than under the SEC.

latest.title: How quant funds beat the market by being 'early, contrarian and right'
latest.description: Quantitative hedge funds have captured big trends in bonds and oil to outperform the stock market this year.

latest.title: U.S. scraps proposed $10,000 reporting rule for for crypto sent to private wallets
latest.description: FinCEN withdrew two proposals that had hung over self-custody and crypto mixers for years without ever taking effect.

latest.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam test gets last-minute fix before major capacity jump
latest.description: One of Ethereum’s main validator clients updated its software hours before a Sepolia test that will raise the amount of work each block can hold to 200 million gas.

latest.title: Bitcoin keeps getting rejected at $87,000 as stocks hover near records
latest.description: BTC fell back to about $85,600 after sellers turned it away from $87,000 for the third time since Sept. 23, while Nasdaq closed at a record and Treasury yields kept climbing.

latest.title: Solana Foundation unveils a program to settle institutional trades in seconds. JPMorgan gave input
latest.description: Solana Foundation launched an open-source program that lets institutions settle trades in seconds, not days. JPMorgan provided key inputs.

latest.title: World Bank warns of AI concentration risks as it lifts East Asia and Pacific growth outlook to 4.5%
latest.description: The World Bank now expects the region to grow 4.5% this year, but flagged that trade growth outside AI-related goods has been "weak or negative."

latest.title: Rain seeks US trust bank charter days after OCC sued over crypto charters
latest.description: Rain joins a growing queue of crypto firms seeking federal trust charters, while community banks have just asked a court to overturn the OCC rules underpinning them.

latest.title: OKX eyes emerging markets with yield-offering stablecoin savings and payments app
latest.description: OKX Money lets users hold, send and spend dollar-backed stablecoins, with qualifying USDG balances earning up to 10% APY.

latest.title: Little room for ‘giving and taking’: India’s finance minister confirms trade impasse with the U.S.
latest.description: In the latest sign of growing skepticism around the closure of the trade deal between New Delhi and Washington, an Indian minister said there is little room for ‘giving and taking.’

latest.title: Pentagon says Trump approves Army firing squad execution of Fort Hood killer Nidal Hasan
latest.description: Former Army Maj. Nidal Hassan was sentenced to death after a court-martial that convicted him of killing 13 and wounding 32 others at an Army base in Texas.

latest.title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
latest.description: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.

latest.title: Trump says MAGA Inc. PAC will pay for controversial TV ads that government funded
latest.description: The New York Times reported "Trump personally instructed his budget director to use taxpayer money for TV ads praising him and his presidency."

latest.title: Trump offers U.S. help to Russia after plague death; WHO assesses the situation as low risk
latest.description: WHO said it was in contact with Russian authorities, and has offered support if needed, while assessing the risk to the general public as low based on available information.

latest.title: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT
latest.description: ZachXBT says he infiltrated the network by posing as a customer, gaining information that helped trace funds from the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.

latest.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Starbucks enters Xinjiang in calculated geopolitical risk
latest.description: Starbucks struck one of Asia's most closely watched deals last year. Now it is getting headaches over choices made by a partner that leans toward Beijing.

latest.title: AI researcher warns 'we are racing to build and grow our own adversary' in NYC hearing
latest.description: The leading AI labs facing intensifying scrutiny over their safety and security practices.

latest.title: Russian gold floods Hong Kong as Western sanctions redraw bullion trade
latest.description: The surge underscores how Russia's gold trade has been rerouted after its invasion of Ukraine in 2022 shut its producers out of major Western markets.
